trello.name: Renew and deploy SSL and internal CA certificates
trello.desc: Ben to renew the wildcard SSL certificate for api.ourapp.com (expires September 1st) and deploy it to the load balancers by August 22nd to allow buffer. Also rotate the internal CA cert that signs the service mesh, which expires two weeks after the public one, in the same change window. Move both certificates onto cert-manager so they auto-renew going forward.

trello.name: PDF export feature for reports
trello.desc: Aisha to implement the full PDF export feature by end of month. Backend renders reports to PDF using headless Chrome; frontend adds an export button and a progress state for large reports. Also record a short demo GIF of the export feature for the marketing changelog as part of finishing the feature.

trello.name: Staging parity: run pending migrations and set up nightly schema diff job
trello.desc: Ben to run the three pending migrations on staging today to bring it to parity with production, and write a nightly job that diffs the staging schema against production and posts to the infra channel if they diverge.
